item.title: The Palestine Occupation and Its Impact to Millennial’s Intention to Boycott Israeli Related Products in Indonesia
item.description: This study examines the impact of Palestine’s occupation on Indonesian millennials' intentions to boycott Israeli-affiliated products, focusing on attitude, perceived behavioral control, and subjective norm as determinants. item.title: Waqf for Economic Empowerment in Indonesia: Assessing the Effect of Institutional Trust and Waqf Innovation Using SEM-PLS
item.description: Waqf is an Islamic philanthropic instrument with significant potential to support sustainable economic empowerment in society. item.title: The Integrating Sharīʿah Principles into Digital Finance: Implications for Taxing Cryptocurrency Transactions
item.description: This study examines the implementation of tax on cryptocurrency transactions from an Islamic legal perspective.
